title: Efficiency of Proximal Survival Contrasts with Finite Redundant Proxies under Right Censoring
banked_reason: Delivered tier subfield < floor field; not salvageable within scope. Independent validity audit found redundant tail assumptions to be hygiene, not invalid proofs; discovery remains unformalized.
gap_reasons: The headline settles retention and exact variance loss for a specified transferred selector on the maintained finite-proxy interior chart; it establishes no dominance over unspecified published PDR procedures. The optimization component closely specializes existing uncensored bridge weighting and range comparisons, so its independent contribution rests on the positive causal realization and complete tangent certification ([Chen–Xie](https://cowles.yale.edu/sites/default/files/2026-03/d2497.pdf), [Ai–Shan](https://arxiv.org/html/2501.02214v2)). The supplied analytic proofs address the inverse-DQM bottleneck, and the framing does not present continuation through every existing latent representation as established. Applicability remains confined by the newly maintained uniform baseline, rank, bridge, density and terminal-risk margins, while unconditional uniform attainment covers only fixed finite supports. The reproducible strict-loss witness establishes possible gains but supplies no finite-sample assessment of fitted selection or evidence of their prevalence in applications, constraining the projected leading-journal score. The precise equation-(5)/Appendix-A attribution to Martinussen–Scheike requires source verification because its published full text was inaccessible during this review ([publication record](https://researchprofiles.ku.dk/en/publications/efficienti-tisub0sub-year-risk-regression-using-the-logistic-mode/)). proof_attempt_summary: The discovery developed the finite-proxy interior-chart tangent/normal characterization, positive causal path realization, and exact transferred-selector retention and variance-loss formulas. D0.5 graded the delivered package subfield with score ceiling 6.8 below the field threshold 7.4 and found no bounded in-scope novelty repair; the independent terminal validity audit found the unrepaired tail-floor redundancies to be hygiene, not invalid proofs. Six formal cited leaves were source-attested, but the Martinussen–Scheike equation-(5)/Appendix-A locator remains unverified; F never began and no Lean certification is claimed.
tldr: An observable range condition characterizes exactly when an uncensored efficient proximal bridge retains efficiency after right censoring: \(\nu_Gv_F\in\operatorname{ran}(\mathsf T)\). Its exact excess variance is \(E_{P^F}[\kappa_G(v_F-v_G)^2]\). This range-retention theorem is the single headline for a fixed-horizon causal survival contrast with finite redundant proxies. Positive causal realization, complete full and observed tangent certification, and inverse-DQM reconstruction support the causal interpretation on explicitly newly maintained quantitative interior charts with arbitrary standard Borel covariates. A single substantive positive-continuation theorem proves structural DQM lifting for every dominated factual full-event DQM path with a jointly parameter/record-measurable density version through its constructed base realization, including arbitrary square-integrable scores, moving covariate marginals and null-fibre occupation. Its short answer corollary records the exact measurable-version equivalence, censor-feasibility qualification, including zero left-region reference mass, and bare-root-DQM obstruction. Legal finite and continuous-event members exhibit strict loss. Observable cross-fitted estimation attains the bound under explicit fitted-nuisance premises; uniform 90 percent studentized coverage is confined to a nonempty compact finite-support subclass. Bare root-DQM does not ensure parameter measurability, and continuation through every pre-existing latent representation remains unproved.
gap: Ying, Cui and Tchetgen Tchetgen already construct IPCW PIPW/PDR censored survival estimators in Section 3.1 and establish asymptotic inference in Section 3.2. Chen--Xie and Ai--Shan supply uncensored proxy efficiency; Martinussen--Scheike supply generic censoring reoptimization. Ashby and coauthors supply a censored negative-control survival EIF and efficient cross-fitted estimation, and Gao and coauthors supply a censored negative-control cross-fitted score. These ingredients do not give this finite redundant-proxy criterion \(\nu_Gv_F\in\operatorname{ran}(\mathsf T)\) or its exact transferred-selector loss. Positive causal and complete observed tangent certification are required to make that diagnostic a causal efficiency statement \cite{YingCuiTchetgen2022ProximalSurvival,ChenXie2026LocalOveridentification,AiShan2025EfficientProxyATE,MartinussenScheike2023RiskEfficiency,AshbyEtAl2026NCOEfficient,GaoEtAl2026ProximalEffectModification}.
fill: The range-retention theorem derives the survival-law metric increment, its observable range obstruction and its exact excess variance. A positive joint latent realization, measurable bounded path lifts, moving-marginal conditional Hellinger control and inverse-censor DQM reconstruction certify the model on which this result is canonical. The comparison corollary states the two uncensored recipes and their required observable inputs. The finite-support attainment domain includes stratified categorical severity and scheduled follow-up with nondifferential dropout as well as the strict-loss witness; applicability requires the maintained margins.
